# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Titles:** Class beauty and belle  <sub>[v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Philippa  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Phil Blake  <sub>[v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa possesses acknowledged beauty, charm, big brown eyes, and brown tints that suit yellow silk dresses. She has a crooked smile and curls. On her wedding day, she looked like a dainty fairy.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 c27 P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Philippa is a frivolous, lively, and charming young woman who loves fun and social popularity. Despite her playful and sometimes thoughtless nature, she is deeply unselfish, loyal, and crystal-free from snobbishness. She possesses a stream of ready small talk and considers herself born to charm and amuse others. Though often indecisive, she is capable of holding firm when it truly matters.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c10 P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_

- To win Jonas's heart and make him ask her to marry him  <sub>[v3 c25 P23](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0023), [v3 c27 P2](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0002)</sub>
- To win the Johnson Scholarship in Mathematics  <sub>[v3 c27 P2](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0002)</sub>

## History

Philippa Gordon enrolled at Redmond College, where she immediately established herself as the class beauty and social belle. She quickly befriended Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant, introducing them to her extensive social circle. During her early college years, she struggled to choose between two home-town suitors, Alec and Alonzo. Later, she moved into Patty's Place with Anne, Priscilla, and Stella Maynard, where she learned basic household duties. While spending a summer month at Prospect Point, she met Jonas Blake, a minister and Redmond graduate, with whom she fell in love. Despite her mother's initial resistance, Philippa remained firm in her choice, took the Johnson Scholarship in Mathematics to impress him, and earned his love. She was married to Jonas in June, with Anne serving as her bridesmaid, and subsequently wrote a letter to Gilbert Blythe that encouraged him to pursue Anne again.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013), [v3 c7 P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 c10 P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059), [v3 c16 P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P23](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0023), [v3 c27 P2](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0002), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c38 P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of a wealthy and prominent man from an old, exclusive Bluenose family in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- Her family homestead is Mount Holly
- Her grandfather was a minister  <sub>[v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>
